svg.title: Implemented r2 single-slider shoulder
svg.desc: Engineering common RGB displacement profile as a function of contour inset. It is not a measurement of native lens thickness.

g.text: r2 single-slider common RGB sampling shoulder
D(s) = 7.8 max(1 - s / 7.5, 0)^2; finite support 7.5 dp
Engineering displacement only; not a recovered native height or ray field.
inset s from carrier edge toward the center, dp
